Retrieval-Augmented Generation
Policy answers, grounded in your actual documents.
No made-up policy. Every answer is retrieved from your real password, incident response, and remote access documentation — with sources and a confidence rating attached.
Your question:
How long before passwords expire?
Per the Password Policy, passwords must be changed every 90 days. Accounts are locked after 5 consecutive failed login attempts and require IT to unlock.
Sources: Password Policy Confidence: High
Examples: "What do I do if I suspect a SEV1 incident?" · "Can I VPN in from my personal laptop?"
What's under the hood
01
Chunked and indexed. Policy documents are split into overlapping ~500-word chunks and embedded into a ChromaDB collection, built once per session.
02
Distance-thresholded retrieval. The top 3 matching chunks are pulled back, but anything past a set similarity distance is discarded rather than passed to the model as "context."
03
Answers only from retrieved text. Claude is instructed to answer using only the retrieved chunks — if nothing confident comes back, it says so instead of guessing.
